children: Champion Homes agreed to acquire the assets of Timberline Homes, a manufactured-home retailer concentrated in the Southeast.
Timberline's assets include nine retail locations across Alabama, Mississippi and Florida.
Champion, which produces factory-built housing, said the assets align closely with its manufacturing and distribution in the Southeast region.
Champion is looking to expand its Southeastern footprint and grow its direct-to-consumer strategy by increasing access to retail locations.
The deal is slated to close in Champion's fiscal fourth quarter. All Timberline employees will be offered employment by Champion following the transaction.
